author.name: Reliability Ruth
author.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

challenge.name: The Committed Pallets
challenge.description: A supplier has confirmed a bulk order for a middle aisle promotion that ships next week, leaving no room for model error. #requirements_reuben# insists the acceptance criteria must be fully governed to guarantee the allocation logic is auditable before the trucks leave. #reliability_ruth# argues the criteria are sufficient as manual checks because the physical stock is already committed and the team needs to ship the feature immediately to handle the live orders.

output.content: I have been running the hand over from risk assessment to acceptance criteria by hand for every release. It is a repetitive task that slows down the deployment pipeline for the allocation feature. I want this step to be automated so the system validates the criteria without human intervention. The more of this process that runs on its own, the faster we can ship updates to handle the live orders. I am not asking for a compromise on the speed of delivery. I simply need the tooling to handle the validation logic so the team can focus on the model performance. This automation is essential for keeping the service reliable under load.
output.reclassify_reason: The text states a need for automation to speed up the pipeline, and the explicit statement that 'the more of this process that runs on its own, the faster we can ship' indicates that doing more than the minimum requested would make the author happier.
